algorithm_long: TabPFN-HYD-FT genuinely trains per official outer TRAIN. Composition-group nested three-fold CV independently selects analytic composition260/all370 features, historical TabPFN fine-tuning/MLP schedules and inference alternatives, including positive mixtures of a trained model with the original frozen prior. The selected learned model is refit on the entire own TRAIN; the selected mixture, if any, is fixed by inner CV. All five final fits freeze before fresh-process replay and all 636 held-out predictions. Built with PriorLabs-TabPFN. Retrospective design exposure and the initial official result are disclosed; this rerun does not erase that history.
notes: Only matbench_jdft2d, not all 13 tasks. Corrected native five-fold MAE=29.99157698166102 meV/atom, fold std=9.44184383860221. The original result28.733328891325755 is retained in history and immutable initial commit340be4d210abbc5367fea241f7e496818f98c171; it had fold0 design-selection bias risk. Corrected protocol SHAfe0c7bb3246799c7704ba439a3da77a55d8075e1179aaeccb452f17a706bb63b was frozen before corrected GPU execution; all 1206 historical candidate alternatives are selected only inside each own outer TRAIN. This corrected result replaces the original regardless of score direction. Previously observed labels/results are not claimed unseen. The original public master was interrupted by course catalog resolution before a later GPU submission, then host-resumed with identical frozen public scientific functions; all 21 stages, outputSHA, genuine updates, final model freezes, fresh-process replays and 636 predictions completed. The default single-machine CUDA backend was not separately fully rerun. See REVIEW_RESPONSE.md and validation.json for limits and actual compute. No own outerTEST feedback enters fitting or configuration selection in this corrected run.
